title: About B | Zumba with B
lines: Welcome to Zumba with B in Paris! Discover the story behind the music, the journey from small-town Illinois, and how an unexpected passion turned into an empowering weekly fitness community.
From Illinois to the dance floor

Growing up in a small town in Illinois, dance was a quiet passion I kept mostly to myself. When I moved to California at 20, I started discovering who I truly was. On a total whim at 21, I joined a Zumba class with a friend just to have something fun to do on a random day. That single decision changed everything. I stepped out of my shell, shared my love of dance publicly for the very first time, and later stepped onto the instructor stage.

Teaching Zumba became the defining turning point where I realized I could truly touch someone else's life, just as my own instructors inspired mine. As a certified Zumba instructor now teaching in Paris, my mission is to share holistic wellness—uplifting both your physical and mental health. Every session is designed to fill the room with laughter, high spirits, and genuine self-expression.

In my classes, we treat each other like family. This is your safe haven once a week to let go and simply be yourself. Whether you feel like putting on a full stadium concert performance or simply want to loosen up your muscles, this hour is entirely yours to enjoy. And if you are nervous or think you have two left feet, do not worry at all: as long as you are moving, you are still burning calories!
"Zumba class is the highlight of my week. It is a place completely free of judgment, full of laughs, and such an incredible workout!"
